title: Note carrier
description: What the frontmatter of a carrier in a `notes/` artifact-role directory says about it: what it is called and about, when it was written, which section owns it, what it asserts about other terms, and what it cites. The directory states the kind; glossary term records are held to the term schema instead. Keys beyond these are admitted; relation keys are the relation vocabulary's predicates, folded in by the admitter that compiles this schema.

description.description: One or two sentences saying what the note is about, for readers and retrieval.

date-created.description: The date the note was first written, ISO 8601.

type.description: The kind of note: note, article, explanation, bibliography, research-article, and so on.

science-owner.description: The services section whose science the note belongs to.

visibility.description: Only public opts a note into the anonymous surface.

calendarDatePrefix.description: A Gregorian calendar date at the start of the value.

noteDate.description: A valid calendar day, or a calendar date and time with optional seconds, fractional seconds, and UTC offset. An absent offset stays unspecified.

documentSourceDay.description: A witnessed source day, not a creation assignment to this note.

sourceStatement.description: Authored contextual text, not a content-addressed utterance or a proved claim.

sourceWorkLocator.description: An HTTPS work or evidence locator, without admission or verification of its contents.

repositoryNoteLocator.description: A repository-relative Markdown locator, not an external URL.

noteProvenance.description: Note-origin evidence, distinct from semantic claims. Shared custody fields retain the original Term constraints.

office.description: Authored office or production-pass context; not the author roster.

written-by.description: Authored writing attribution and context; not a replacement for authors.

request.description: The originating request locator, distinct from a question or associated work.

see-also.description: Authored cross-reference descriptions. These do not establish resolved graph edges.

utterance-index.description: Authored index description for consulted utterances, not an exact utterance or content address.

utc-minute.description: Recorded UTC minute, with no inferred seconds or precision.

utterance-citations.description: Content-addressed utterance citations with explicitly witnessed minute precision. Untimed addresses still use utterances.
